listing.name: Destruction Derby 2 / Alexbeav PSXRecomp
listing.summary: Build and play Destruction Derby 2 on Windows or Linux with your own matching USA disc and retail SCPH-1001 BIOS. The upstream setup kit remains a separate route.

steps.title: Download and unpack the setup kit
steps.instruction: Extract the complete official ZIP for your system into a separate writable folder. On Linux or macOS, use native CMake, Ninja, Python 3 and a C/C++ compiler. On a Mac, choose the ZIP for Apple Silicon or Intel and follow its README-SETUP.txt.

steps.title: Supply the matching original files
steps.instruction: Use your own Destruction Derby 2 (USA) disc (SCUS-94350) in a layout supported by the kit. Supply the BIOS that the kit’s README-SETUP.txt names. Keep the CUE and every referenced track together if using a CUE/BIN copy. Follow the original-file instructions included with the kit you downloaded.

steps.title: Build the game and add it to Portcove
steps.instruction: Open the project’s launcher and follow its build instructions. Keep the completed game with its required program and compiler files. In Portcove, select the completed program or supported launcher and its start folder. Save the details, then choose Play.

warnings: Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay for this package.

references.title: Updates and backups
references.instruction: Keep a working copy and its data before changing versions. Use the project’s tools for updates and back up your original files, saves and settings yourself.

presentation.manual_preparation: Provide your own complete matching 19-track USA CHD (SCUS-94350) and retail SCPH-1001 BIOS. A copy installed with the bundled OpenBIOS keeps it until you update; the update needs your SCPH-1001 BIOS. Portcove checks track count and the first data-track SHA-1. Keep the complete disc, including its audio tracks. The other tracks and the complete TOC are not independently authenticated. Use the 19-track CHD from the correct complete USA disc. The merged-BIN digest is a separate upstream setup input. Portcove builds privately with the registered toolchain and launches the generated player. Native generation, gameplay and save compatibility remain unobserved.

steps.title: Set up the managed player
steps.instruction: Select your own matching game files and the required BIOS. Portcove checks the files and builds the player.

warnings: Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay for this package.
Native generation, gameplay and save compatibility remain unobserved.
